records.artwork_title: L'Adoration des mages, par Francisco de Zurbarán
records.object_identity: Musée de Grenoble MG 1325, Zurbarán, Adoration of the Magi, 1638–39
records.findings: French government Joconde 09940005608 and Grenoble museum identify this Magi work. Separate from Grenoble MG1324 Shepherds; institutional photograph credited Grenoble/J.-L. Lacroix (no automatic permission).

records.artwork_title: Le Christ en croix, la Vierge, la Madeleine et saint Jean
records.corrected_attribution: Attribution to Bertholet Flémal UNVERIFIED for exact pictured object
records.object_identity: Commons original photograph in Musée des Augustins Toulouse category; exact institution accession not established from authoritative object metadata
records.findings: Selected 1962 Mass of Our Lady in Paschaltide reads John 19:25-27. Photo shows/caption indicates Christ crucified with Mary/Magdalene/John, but matching the source photograph to an original museum inventory and Flémal credit is not established. Do NOT substitute a similarly titled Flémal work, Toulouse Neri di Bicci RO401, anonymous Spanish inv.48 18 119, Louvre van Dyck INV1766, or other lookalikes.

records.corrected_attribution: Philippe de Champaigne WORKSHOP attribution in cross-gallery catalogue; verify museum current credit

records.findings: Geneva museum accession 1942-0009 corresponds to Commons Champaigne Visitation Genève. Distinguish from Princeton original y1994-17 and Villeneuve-lès-Avignon PL86.1.5, separately catalogued Visitation paintings. records.artwork_title: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist
records.object_identity: Metropolitan Museum of Art 32.100.127 / object search 437738, Spanish Catalan painter, mid-15th century, tempera and gold
records.findings: Exact painting depicts John's beheading; matches 1962 feast's Mark 6:17-29. Met describes public-domain work/open-access commercial/noncommercial images. Still must map exact Met downloadable file to local pixel/crop and owner selected placement.

records.object_identity: Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk (Church of Our Lady) Bruges; Jacob van Oost the Elder Calling of Saint Matthew (circa 1640–48), RKD work 61819; church-owned setting not assumed Groeningemuseum accession
records.findings: Dutch RKD catalogue records Calling of Matthew at Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk with citations and WWII restitution; Open Kerken confirms this work in church, distinct from generic Musea Brugge 'photographer/source'. Matches Matthew 9:9-13. Exact local image origin/rights need verification.

records.corrected_attribution: Annibale Carracci (attribution in Commons/Wikidata; museum reconciliation pending)
records.object_identity: Musée des Beaux-Arts d'Orléans 192; Wikidata/Joconde 00000102967 identify Annibale Carracci Adoration of the Shepherds
records.findings: Actual 1962 Octave Feria 30 Dec Gospel Luke 2:15-20 includes shepherds discovering newborn. Commons lists Orléans accession 192 and 1280x1624px image; did not independently verify current museum attribution/source, so no image asset promotion from Commons alone.

records.object_identity: Musée de Grenoble MG84; Louvre-owned Jacob Jordaens oil painting (ca 1617), deposited Grenoble
records.findings: Grenoble museum and Louvre collection independently identify MG84 (same physical work). Dec31 Christmas-Octave feria repeats Luke 2:15-20. Distinct from Orléans Carracci work. Museum photographic credit Grenoble/J.-L. Lacroix; not thereby commercial-app cleared.
